check: Inventory_Value does not equal stock x unit cost
rationale: The supplied value swings from 0.05x to 15x stock-at-cost, so it cannot be trusted for rupee impact.

check: Snapshots are monthly and do not roll forward from sales
action: Latest snapshot used as the current stock position; no roll-forward
rationale: Month-to-month stock jumps are unrelated to sales, so projecting stock from sales would invent numbers. We score risk as of the latest snapshot date instead.
